verdict.rationale: The evidence documents HyperAgent's page.ai() for acting directly and page.extract() for pulling structured data. Nothing shows an observe/plan primitive that returns candidate actions for review before the agent commits. Extraction, live viewing and post-hoc recordings are adjacent features and do not preview pending actions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
